separate.license.notice.htdemucs: The model maintainer said in Demucs discussion #327 that these weights were not covered by the code’s MIT license and were for scientific use only. The audio.cpp card lists MIT and commercial use, but no original source confirms that claim. Usage rights for these weights therefore remain unclear. audio.cpp’s Apache-2.0 license covers its code, not the weights.
separate.license.notice.htdemucs6s: The six-track version is part of the same model family, but its weight license has not been verified. The model maintainer said in Demucs discussion #327 that the weights were not covered by the code’s MIT license and were for scientific use only. The audio.cpp card lists MIT and commercial use without confirmation from an original source. Usage rights for these weights remain unclear.
separate.license.notice.bsRoformer: The source of the BS-RoFormer ep368 weights is undocumented. The conversion repository lists Apache-2.0, but without the original source we cannot confirm the weights’ license. Their usage terms still need review.
separate.license.notice.melRoformer: The Kim Vocal model card lists MIT. The author has also said the weights are for personal or research use. These statements do not match, so confirm the usage terms before choosing this model.
